How Far From Its Mode a Fit Is, and What It Does Not Identify

Source: R/bootstrap_engine.R
boot_read_mode.Rd

Returns \(\tfrac12 g'K^{-1}g\) at the coefficients, as the certificate reads it, and the coordinates that the penalized information does not identify there.

Usage

boot_read_mode(
  object,
  spec,
  design,
  cf,
  hy,
  cfg,
  pinned = object@methods$pinned
)

Arguments

object

The StatmodFit(), for its criterion and pinned coordinates.

spec, design

The specification and design where the point is read.

cf, hy

The coefficients and hyperparameters.

cfg

The inner settings of the fit.

pinned

The pinned coordinates at the point read, in its own stacked positions; those of the fit by default.

Value

A list with me (a number, NA if the point could not be read), def (stacked positions) and singular (whether the penalized information could not be factorized).

Details

The coefficients that the marginal criterion estimates are held, as the certificate holds them, and the coordinates of a kinked penalty that are zero are left out of the score. The information is that of the inner fit. The unidentified coordinates are those that ctx_penalized() pins, apart from the ones pinned for another reason: a coefficient whose observations all have a zero weight is among them, although the inner fit does not report it as aliased.
